Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Vendor onboarding checklist + payment owners and PO workflow

Hi Helen / ProcureOps team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great to meet the team. Quick recap from our discovery and a few asks so we can map the onboarding timeline: 

- Economic buyer: as we confirmed, Daniel Park (Eng Ops) is the approval owner for pilot spend. Please confirm if we should also loop in Finance (Accounts Payable) for PO routing.
- Procurement path: you mentioned a standard PO + invoice route. Can you confirm the billing contact and the exact invoice email to avoid delays? 
- Required vendor docs: we typically provide a W-9, vendor intake form, SOC 2 report, and DPA. I attached the intake form and W-9 for your vendor portal.
- Timeline ask: our typical pilot kicks off once PO is issued — target start 3–4 weeks after PO. If Acme needs legal redlines, that adds time; please indicate any gating steps.

Action items (from Redwood):
1) Share vendor paperwork (attached) and links to SOC2/DPA (we can provide hosted links).
2) Align on PO formatting (billing address, PO fields).
3) Identify the AP contact and estimated PO issuance date.

Ben / Marissa — looping you in to keep sales and CS aligned on the timeline and to capture any commercial asks.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf, Redwood_W9.pdf

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding checklist + payment owners and PO workflow

Hi Camila — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A few clarifications from ProcureOps: 

- Billing / AP contact: please send invoices to ap-payments@acmefinancial.com. Invoices must reference the PO number; if a PO is not available at invoice time, we cannot guarantee payment timing.
- PO process: Procurement issues POs once vendor intake + legal sign-off are complete. Typical timeline for a standard SaaS pilot is 3–6 weeks depending on legal review.
- Remit and address: Acme Financial Corp.
  200 Market St.
  Accounts Payable
  San Francisco, CA 94105

- Required docs: Vendor intake form (received), W-9 (received), SOC 2 Type II (required), DPA (required). We accept hosted SOC2 links behind a permissions ACL (e.g., Box or Google Drive link) or a packaged PDF.
- PO template: attaching our standard PO template for your reference (Acme_PO_Template.pdf). Please ensure invoice lines match the PO description to prevent audit rework.

Next steps from our side: I'll route the intake materials to Legal and Finance. If Legal needs redlines, I'll flag them and we can coordinate. Expect an update by next Wednesday with any gating issues.

Regards,
Helen Cho
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Financial
helen.cho@acmefinancial.com | +1 (415) 555-7800

Thanks Helen — useful. Couple quick items from Redwood finance/commercial perspective: 

- Deal ID: RDW-2143 (pilot, $30k TCV) — we'll need the PO to match that deal id somewhere in the invoice or description.
- Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net 30; we can accept Net 45 for enterprise if required but would prefer Net 30 for pilot. Please let us know if your AP requires different terms.
- SOC2/DPA delivery: we can provide a read-only Google Drive link to the SOC2 package and a standard Redwood DPA PDF. Camila — can you share those links here so Helen can pass to Legal?

I'll stay on standby for the PO issuance and any legal redlines. If it helps, we can provide a brief one-page summary of the technical controls to expedite Legal review.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

Ben / Camila — quick update from Procurement & Legal: 

- Legal intake: they received the vendor intake form and W-9. Legal has requested a short SOC2 summary and the DPA; please provide links or PDFs by EOD to keep timeline.
- PO timing: assuming no redlines, Procurement expects to issue a PO in ~3 weeks. If Legal requests redlines, add another 1–2 weeks.
- Invoice note: Invoice must include the PO number and reference RDW-2143 in the invoice description line.
- Pilot start: once PO is in hand and initial payment clears, internal Ops will schedule access and a kickoff (typically 3–5 business days after payment).

I'll create a SharePoint folder for the legal packet and send a link once it's ready. In the meantime, please upload SOC2/DPA to the Google Drive link you mentioned and share view permissions for legal@acmefinancial.com.

Plan: Helen will update by 2027-03-03 with either the PO or any legal redline notes.

Thanks,
Helen Cho
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Financial
